items.claim: Secret comparisons go through subtle::ConstantTimeEq via constant_time_eq; no early-exit equality on secret bytes.
items.title: Constant-time comparison for secret material

items.claim: SecretBytes wraps Zeroizing<[u8; 32]> so key material is wiped when it leaves scope.
items.title: Secret material zeroized on drop

items.claim: Debug for SecretBytes prints [REDACTED] and no Display impl can print secret bytes.
items.title: Debug redaction for secrets

items.claim: verify_raw rejects non-canonical S values (S >= L) before verification with a distinct NonCanonicalSignature error, independent of dependency-internal checks.
items.title: Signature malleability check (S < L)

items.claim: Domain::tag() assigns a distinct stable tag to Tx, Vote, Block, Contract and Genesis; cross-domain signatures are rejected.
items.title: Domain separation covers all five domains

items.claim: hash_domain binds chain_id into the signed digest; a signature made for one chain fails on another.
items.title: Chain binding in the signed digest

items.claim: domain_message encodes prefix and payload lengths as u64 little-endian before each segment; concatenation is unambiguous.
items.title: Unambiguous length-prefixed message layout

items.claim: HASH_CONTEXT is pinned at AuraLite-Crypto/crypto-v1 and changing it is a protocol change requiring a new phase.
items.title: Versioned hash context is a protocol constant

items.claim: ML-DSA is the designated PQ signature upgrade; the hybrid migration plan is recorded in this document.
items.title: Post-quantum primary: ML-DSA (FIPS 204)

items.claim: SLH-DSA is the designated stateless hash-based backup if ML-DSA is weakened; the fallback plan is recorded in this document.
items.title: Post-quantum backup: SLH-DSA (FIPS 205)
